root.label: BBC report on Instagram fake copyright ransom scams

events.label: BBC report on Instagram fake copyright ransom scams

slots.name: ransom payment
slots.sentence: One Instagram user, who has 1.5 million followers, told the BBC he paid a scammer $50 (£37) to get his account back, claiming Meta's appeal process would take weeks, which had previously cost him thousands in lost income.

slots.name: follower count
slots.sentence: The Lost in Time History Instagram account posts historical pictures to its more than 1.5 million followers.

slots.name: monthly fee
slots.sentence: Meta charges a £9.99 monthly fee to be Verified on Instagram, which gives users 24/7 access to support via a live chat.

slots.name: people interviewed
slots.sentence: The BBC has spoken to three people who file copyright strikes against Instagram users, despite not being the copyright holders.

slots.name: strike withdrawal demand
slots.sentence: But the BBC has seen messages from one where they ask for $900 (£668) to withdraw a strike.
